description: Persist a named OpenClaw gateway config (URL + token) to local store. Default instance name is 'default'. Pass `instance` to manage multiple gateways (e.g. 'perso', 'work') from the same MCP. Env vars (OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_URL/TOKEN) still override everything stored here — leave them unset to use named instances. After saving, the matching client connection is closed so the next tool call re-handshakes with the new credentials.

gatewayPassword.description: Optional extra password if your gateway is configured with one

gatewayToken.description: Gateway login token (get it from your Hostinger VPS dashboard or the Control panel after login)

gatewayUrl.description: WebSocket URL of the gateway, e.g. wss://your-gateway.example.com or ws://127.0.0.1:18789

instance.description: Instance name (e.g. 'default', 'perso', 'work'). Defaults to 'default'. The first instance configured becomes the default automatically.

makeDefault.description: If true, also set this instance as the active default (for tools that don't pass `instance`).

name: openclaw_setup
